reason: The outline Button's 1px border is Tailwind's `border`, which has no width scale to bind to, and Figma has no border-width variable.

The ghost Button has no fill, and Figma casts a fill-less frame's shadow from its text, so its focus ring can't be the spread shadows the other variants use; it is a rectangle 4px outside the button instead. Its 2px stroke is `ring-2`, which has no Figma variable. Covered by looking: the screenshot comparison in CLAUDE.md's Checking the result against Figma.
The ghost focus ring rectangle (see its strokeWeight entry): its 10px corners are the button's 6px radius plus the ring's 4px reach, which no radius variable has.
